subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My dog / barks / very louder / at night.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of "very louder".
 
• The correct comparative form should be "very loudly" or simply "louder".
 
• The correct phrase should be "barks very loudly" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My dog barks very loudly at night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"My dog"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"barks"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"at night"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
